title: Signup Validation - Age Restriction
description: Attempt to sign up with age < 18 (e.g., age 17). Verify server rejects with status 422 or 400 validation error.
expected_result: API rejects registration and returns error indicating age must be at least 18.
comments: Successfully verified via pytest boundary testing.

title: Signup Validation - Duplicate Email
description: Attempt to sign up twice using the same email address. Verify duplicate email error (status 400).
expected_result: API rejects duplicate email with status 400 and message 'Email already registered'.
comments: Successfully verified via duplicate email regression checks.

title: Signup Success
description: Verify registration works for a new user with valid name, age, email, password, phone, and interests.
expected_result: User registered successfully, token and public profile returned, status 200.

title: Login Validation - Empty Fields
description: Attempt login with empty email or empty password. Verify API returns validation errors.
expected_result: API returns 422 Unprocessable Entity for missing required body fields.

title: Login Validation - Incorrect Password
description: Attempt login with a registered email but wrong password. Verify HTTP 401 response.
expected_result: API returns status 401 Unauthorized with message 'Invalid email or password'.

title: Login Success
description: Verify login returns a valid JWT token and public profile for a registered user.
expected_result: Successful login with valid token and matching user info.

title: Token Persistence
description: Verify AsyncStorage stores token key 'safeconnect_token' upon successful login.
expected_result: AsyncStorage.setItem is called with 'safeconnect_token' and token value.
comments: Verified via AsyncStorage mock interface checks.

title: Token Validity check
description: Verify token decoding on server using PyJWT and HS256 matches expected payload.
expected_result: Server successfully decodes payload, extracts user id, and validates expiration.

title: Get Profile endpoint (/auth/me)
description: Retrieve profile using valid token. Verify API returns public user details.
expected_result: Response contains user name, email, phone, avatar, verified status, rating.

title: UI/UX - Brand Colors & Logo styling
description: Verify logo and title display as 'saFeConnect' with feminine pink/rose styling.

comments: Verified on web landing screen rendering.

expected_result: Eye icon toggle successfully changes secureTextEntry true/false.

title: Validation - Malformed Email checks
